limitations: Observations start after first-wave epoch1, not at stage launch.
Cgroup CPU counters cover the shared cgroup, not an individual experiment.
Throttled microseconds are counter deltas, not a wall-time percentage.
Point-sampled GPU utilization, clocks and flags can miss brief events.
Batch/LR assignments are not randomized across physical GPUs, so timing comparisons are device/contention confounded.
purpose: describe device/runtime contention; no scientific score selection
